meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容编排成可翻页的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把想法整理成演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Create a navigable slideshow from your content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need to turn ideas into a slide deck

howto.what: 当你要做幻灯片时,Claude 会产出可翻页的 HyperFrames 演示,内含独立幻灯片、片段展开、分支跳转和带讲者备注的演示模式;不输出视频。转换现有页面时会尽量保留原设计。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求做幻灯片,或提到“演示文稿”、“融资演讲”等词,或要求把网页转成演示时触发。若请求不是明确要幻灯片,会先确认是否做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品发布会的幻灯片
say.note: 会生成可导航的 HyperFrames deck

say.text: 把这个网页转成幻灯片,保留原设计
say.note: 会先确认,再按原页面风格移植

say.text: 在第二页加个热点,点击跳到市场测算
say.note: 会配置热点与分支,可点击跳转

howto.what_en: When you ask for a slideshow, Claude builds a runnable HyperFrames deck: separate slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and presenter mode with notes — served in the browser, not as a video. Converting a page preserves its design and interactions as closely as practical.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, mention 'presentation' or 'pitch deck', or ask to turn a webpage into a deck. Adjacent requests get a confirmation question first; /hyperframes-issued requests are already confirmed.

say_en.text: Turn this webpage into a slideshow, keep its look
say_en.note: Confirms first, then ports the design

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 2 that jumps to market sizing
say_en.note: Wires the hotspot to a branch sequence
